question: Which of the following was NOT an aim of the satellite INSAT-1B?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Protecting the national borders**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **INSAT-1B **was built by Ford Aerospace and operated by the Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO).
 
• On 30 August **1983**, Indian communications satellite INSAT-1B was launched from the Kennedy Space Center, Florida, USA
 
• It provided direct **television **and **communications **to the whole country. It also provided **weather **forecasting and **disaster **warning services.
 
• in July 1990, the INSAT-1B was replaced by the INSAT-1D

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **INSAT-1A was the first satellite in the INSAT **series to be launched by ISRO in 1982.
 
• **ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation)**
 
 
• Founded on **August 15, 1969**
 
• **Headquarter **- Banglore 
 
• **First Chairman **- **Vikram Sarabhai**
 
• **Current Chairman** -** Sreedhara Somnath** (DECEMBER 2022) 
 
• ISRO built India's first satellite, **Aryabhata**, which was launched by the Soviet Union in **1975**.
 
 
 
• **NASA ( National Aeronautics and Space Administration)**
 
 
• **​**NASA was established in **1958**.
